course.title: Microsoft Copilot for AI-Enabled Scrum Masters
course.description: A world-class course transforming Scrum Masters into AI-native practitioners who leverage Microsoft Copilot for predictive intelligence, organizational impact, and continuous improvement
course.targetAudience: Experienced Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches

objectives: Set up optimal workspace for SM workflows

Synthesize retrospective feedback

modules.title: Researcher & Analyst Agents

modules.title: Building Context with Memory
objectives: Use Copilot Memory for team context
Create context documents for the Velocity Squad
Manage persistent team knowledge

modules.title: Copilot Across M365 Apps
objectives: Use Copilot in Word for sprint documentation
Use Copilot in Excel for metrics tracking

modules.title: Copilot in Microsoft Teams
objectives: Get meeting summaries from ceremonies
Catch up on missed standups

objectives: Draft stakeholder updates with appropriate tone

objectives: Analyze team health survey results
Prepare for coaching conversations
